thread:
sam: Pushing a quick idea - attach a tiny action strip to each streaming message: [Stop] [Regenerate] and a tiny token badge. Keeps actions contextually next to the output. https://figma.redwood/playground/strip-v1

elaine: Love the locality. Two quick asks: 1) make sure hit targets are >= 44px, 2) the token badge should be low-contrast so it doesn't scream.

mike: Runtime note: stop must cancel inflight writes and still persist partial text as final. Regenerate should spawn a new response_id. Please include response_id in events.

zoe: Accessibility: prefer separate labeled buttons (aria-label="Stop response") not icon-only, and use aria-live="polite" on the stream container. Also ensure focus order: actions after the message body.

sam: Good. Keyboard mapping proposal: Esc = stop (message focused), R = regenerate (when action strip focused), K = open prompt quick-palette. Any collisions?

elaine: R is fine as long as it requires focus in the actions row. Don't override Cmd/Ctrl+R unless composer is focused.

ux-bot: Suggested analytics events: playground.stream.stop, playground.stream.regen, playground.token.open. Props: response_id, token_estimate, token_delta.\nzoe: Motion: remove shimmer animation under prefers-reduced-motion. Also avoid layout shifts when tokens arrive - prefer opacity fades. Snippet:

"@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .shimmer{ animation:none } }"

mike: For token wording propose: "~24 tokens • $0.002" and on regen show "+3 tokens" in green. Also add an optional ETA: "~1.1s left" shown only when estimate variance < 30%.

sam: Prompt library access: keep compact quick-palette (Cmd+K) for power users; also allow slide-over for browsing. The strip can have a small "+" to insert a prompt inline which pauses rendering and confirms insertion.

elaine: Edge case: mobile layout - action strip should collapse into an overflow menu to avoid cramped buttons. Also test with VoiceOver on iOS.

mike: Dev action: ensure regenerate checks quota and warns if projected tokens > remaining session budget. UI should show a subtle modal saying "This regenerate will use ~X tokens" and let user confirm.\nsam: Action items:
- Design: final sizes, color tokens, overflow menu behavior (sam)
- Dev: stop/regenerate semantics, quota confirm, reduced-motion (mike)
- A11y: aria labels, focus order, screen reader testing (zoe)
- Analytics: confirm schema (ux-bot)

elaine: I'll mark comp ready and file UI-PL-9123. :thumbsup:

ux-bot: Created ticket UI-PL-9123 (playground: message action strip + per-response token badge + prompt quick-insert).
